text: In 2012, the Katy, Tex. Independent School District removed Chuck Palahniuk's Fight Club from its required reading list following parental complaints about the book’s violent nature and explicit undertones. At Seven Lakes High School in Katy, TX, it was replaced by V for Vendetta.
